subject: planner: typo in index costing (#59240)
summary: Reviewed diff vs parent for planner-only changes. The commit fixes `PhysicalIndexLookUpReader.GetPlanCostVer2` to compute `tableRows` from `p.tablePlan` (not `p.indexPlan`), aligning the table-side network cost with the actual table-plan cardinality; this matches the surrounding cost-model structure (TableReader uses table-plan cardinality) and only affects estimated cost/EXPLAIN output, not query semantics or runtime behavior.
